8863:
Before learning of your appointment, you have studied the basics of the ninja world, and now it's time to test what you have learned.
In the Verdant Alley Sunflowers have grown and suddenly started attacking passing travelers. We cannot let them go on like this; all you have to do is stop the crazy actions of these Sunflowers .
8864:
With the crisis over, the Village Elder has decided to hold a banquet to celebrate.
Speaking of banquets, we must not leave out sushi, the finest delicacy in all of Sakura Plain . Just thinking about it makes my mouth water. But for unknown reasons, the Sushi Monsters have stopped producing sushi. Oh, woe to us if we have to live without sushi!
You must look for the Sushi Monsters in the Smelting Mountains and get delicious sushi from them for the banquet. This is an important mission, and I trust you will not disappoint me.
8865:
A series of disturbances has occurred in the Verdant Alley recently, and it turns out it's not only in the Verdant Alley . Many of these disturbances have happened in the Sakura Plain as well. All these disturbances are connected to one another.
To confirm the truth, I sent a Genin to investigate the respective areas. The time to report has come, but the Genin has not yet arrived. Perhaps he is having trouble on the road.
Now I need to send an envoy to the Verdant Alley to investigate, and the Jounin recommended you. This mission is very important, you must give it your best effort.
8866:
After gathering information, I was attacked by a group calling themselves the Scarlet Bandits on the way home. So I had to hide here.
Only by wiping out these bandits can we return to the village safely.
8867:
You were sent by the Village Elder and must be the scout. Because of the sudden attack by bandits, to prevent the information from falling into their hands, I let the ninja dog escape with its cleverness.
Find the ninja dog, and you will have the information.
8868: Woof! Woof! So my master sent you to get the information from me. The clever <font color='#00b034'> Pakkun </font>will not lose anything important.
8869:
So it turns out someone is coordinating behind all these events. The Genin even mentioned that the demons in the Smelting Mountains may be uniting to attack the village.
To prevent this, I have decided to send an elite platoon of guards to hold back the demons. You have proven your excellent performance, so you must join this mission.
8870: I don't know where<font color='#00b034'> Pakkun </font>ran off to now, can you help me find him?
8871:
You have completed this mission. Now it's time for you to learn something.
Relax, and listen to me patiently.
8872:

If you can get rid of the thieving Potato Demons , you will pass the trial and qualify to take part in the training in Angel City . Of course, the Potato Demons are not like the monsters you have defeated so far, don't rush in unless you are sure to win.

8874: The nearby<font color='#00b034'> Monkeys </font>stole my straw hat while I was resting. If I weren't watching the rest of my goods, I'd teach them a lesson. Since you're here, please help me get my straw hat back from them.
